title: Stress recovery theory

definition.text: The idea that contact with nature helps the body and emotions recover from stress, lowering cortisol and heart rate.

facts.text: It is usually discussed alongside attention restoration theory; the two describe complementary ways nature may benefit wellbeing.
The benefits of nature therapy are usually linked to this stress recovery process.
Urban forestry has been shown to promote stress recovery and psychological healing.

notes: Phrase concept; the source calls it Stress Reduction Theory (SRT).
